Hero_Desc_UiMemory:
The real Ui, the original from whom Ui, Spirit of Drizzle, was created.
Long ago, she wished to erase her unhappy memories, created a false self, and hid within the lingering reflection of a pond.
Unlike the ever-smiling Spirit of Drizzle, this Ui carries herself with a serious demeanor.
Gacha_Result_HeroTitle_UiMemory: The Clover That Bloomed Beyond the Past
Album_Hate_UiMemory: Misfortune, things that make her feel unhappy
Album_Hobby_UiMemory: Talking with Vivi by the pond
Album_UiMemory1: This Ui is not the Ui of Spirit Mountain whom we have known until now. Sometimes I forget that, speak to her, and startle when she answers coldly. But at heart she is still the same kind Ui. I should learn to accept her as she is now.
Album_UiMemory2: Lately, I've noticed that Apostles who knew Ui from Spirit Mountain are often startled by her current demeanor. Those unaware of what happened sometimes mistake her for having turned bitter. I cannot reveal everything to every Apostle, so I am wondering how to help them accept Ui as she is now.
Album_UiMemory3: Ui asked what she should do to become happy. I advised her to begin by looking around at everyday life and getting to know the Apostles around her little by little. She muttered something to herself, then said she understood and left.
Album_UiMemory4: Ui has been attending the sisters' gatherings organized by Vivi. She hesitated at first, but her sisters looked after her, and now she has settled in and talks with them often.
Album_UiMemory5: Ui seemed upset. Apparently, getting close to Apostles she had just met had not gone well. She said she missed Eru and wanted to hide in the pond again like before. Finding happiness while carrying pain is hard, so I told her to come talk whenever things became difficult. Ui sniffled and quietly said she understood.
Album_UiMemory6: Recently, Ui often visits the pond with Vivi and talks with her for a long time. Whenever she wants to hide in the pond, she speaks with Vivi beside it until she regains her composure. When the two talk alone, memories of their shared past return and put her heart at ease.
Album_UiMemory7: Once, Ui invited me to visit the pond with her. When I asked whether she had called me because she was feeling down, she said no. After hesitating, she thanked me for always staying beside her when things were hard and smiled as she asked me to keep looking after her. Her smile was as warm as spring sunlight.
LoveHero_UiMemory: Master... will you come with me?
LoveHeroCancel_UiMemory: Hmph... go back or don't. Do whatever you want.
Food_ChefNote_UiMemory_Hate1: She flatly rejected it, saying bitterness made her feel unhappy. Something about it tasting like the bitterness of reality.
Food_ChefNote_UiMemory_Hate2: Ui declared that the smell of this food invited misfortune. She kept frowning until the pumpkin scent finally faded.
Food_ChefNote_UiMemory_Like1: She says this food smells like the pond where she once hid. The scent gives her a strangely comforting sense of calm.
Food_ChefNote_UiMemory_Like10: She says this food fills her with energy and happiness for the whole day, making her feel as though she can do anything.
Food_ChefNote_UiMemory_Like2: Ui says the shape of the meat reminds her of the past. Judging by her smile, it must have been a happy memory.
Food_ChefNote_UiMemory_Like3: It reminded her of when her other self turned a tree into cake for the fairies. Apparently, it was neither as soft nor as sweet as this food.
Food_ChefNote_UiMemory_Like4: She mixed it with water and drank it in one go, saying its sharp kick felt refreshing and uplifting. She seems surprisingly fond of sour flavors.
Food_ChefNote_UiMemory_Like5: She enjoyed its colorful appearance and chewy texture, saying it was unlike anything she had eaten before.
Food_ChefNote_UiMemory_Like6: She says the rich sweetness and crisp texture bring her happiness. She looked so pleased eating them that I gave her a few more.
Food_ChefNote_UiMemory_Like7: She likes the sweet-and-sour burst when she tosses it into her mouth and crunches down. She says it lets her feel a small, simple happiness.
Food_ChefNote_UiMemory_Like8: Ui had been eating happily, but fell quiet as soon as she mentioned Eru. It seems she remembered sharing food with Eru.
Food_ChefNote_UiMemory_Like9: She likes that this candy lets her forget unpleasant feelings for a while. She wishes the unhappiness of reality could melt away just as sweetly.
Gacha_Result_SpecialLine1_UiMemory: Beyond the river of misery, one step forward.
Gacha_Result_Line1_UiMemory: Even if it's only a little at a time... I'll keep moving toward happiness.
UiMemory_Growth2: It's not like I got any taller...
UiMemory_Victory1: It's not like I'm that happy about this. I-I mean it...
UiMemory_Victory2: Does this mean I'm a little happier now?
UiMemory_Defeat2: Ugh... I don't want to retreat like this...
UiMemory_Affinity1_1: Hello, Master. What do you think of the new me?
UiMemory_Affinity1_2: This is the real me. I've decided not to lie anymore.
UiMemory_Affinity2: Master. I don't look strange now, do I? Right?
UiMemory_Affinity1_3: What will Eru say when she sees me? Do you think she'll be surprised?
UiMemory_Affinity3: Swallowing the pain and searching for happiness isn't easy.
UiMemory_Affinity4: Sometimes when I feel down, I want to hide in the pond again.
UiMemory_Affinity5: Things are often hard, but whenever they are, I think of the sister who brought me out... and of you, Master.
UiMemory_Affinity6: It's strange, but being with you puts my heart at ease. When I think of you beside me... I feel myself becoming happier little by little.
UiMemory_Affinity7: Um, Master. Could you... hold my hand for a little while?
UiMemory_Die1: It's okay. I can still endure this.
UiMemory_LevelUp: I may be a little slow, but I'll keep moving forward.
UiMemory_Equipment: How do I look? Does it suit me?
UiMemory_HeroSkill: My head feels a little clearer.
UiMemory_HeroUpgrade: I just need to keep taking one step at a time, right?
UiMemory_DeckSetting2: So this is where I belong.
UiMemory_Stage: Will you stay by my side?
UiMemory_Touch1_1: Are you going to keep teasing me like this?
UiMemory_Touch2_1: I-it's embarrassing when you keep petting me...
UiMemory_Touch1_2: Didn't I tell you to stop?
UiMemory_Touch2_2: Being with you really does make me happy, Master.
Item_HeroSkin_Desc_UiMemory_Skin1: Ui (Memory) working part-time at a maid cafe. Her prickly way of speaking, at odds with her cute appearance, is part of her charm.
UiMemory_Growth1_Skin1: Here's the omelet rice you ordered.
UiMemory_Growth2_Skin1: If you're done eating, get up. The next customer is waiting.
UiMemory_LevelUp_Skin1: It's not like my hourly pay is going up, right?
UiMemory_Equipment_Skin1: This looks easy to work in.
UiMemory_HeroSkill_Skin1: Yeah, yeah. Become delicious, hyah! There, happy now?
UiMemory_HeroUpgrade_Skin1: Can I clock out an hour early?
UiMemory_Board_Skin1: Draw with ketchup? Ugh, what a pain...
UiMemory_Touch1_Skin1: Could you not pull me around without asking, dear customer?
UiMemory_Touch1_1_Skin1: Keep that up and I'll squirt ketchup all over your face.
UiMemory_Touch2_Skin1: It feels soft and fluffy, like an omelet...
UiMemory_Touch2_1_Skin1: This isn't getting you any extra service...!
UiMemory_DutchRubEnd2_Skin1: You! Want to see what it's like to get pelted with eggs?!
Item_HeroSkin_Desc_UiMemory_Skin2: Ui (Memory) helping her sick friends. Her methods may be a little rough, but her skill is said to be beyond doubt.
UiMemory_Growth1_Skin2: Yes, yes. Please stay still, dear patient.
UiMemory_Growth2_Skin2: Medicine that's good for you is supposed to taste bitter.
UiMemory_LevelUp_Skin2: Now I can cure any illness.
UiMemory_Equipment_Skin2: Will this let me help even more patients?
UiMemory_HeroSkill_Skin2: I think I've found a new treatment.
UiMemory_HeroUpgrade_Skin2: I'll become an even better doctor.
UiMemory_Touch1_Skin2: I said it hurts, so why are you pulling there?!
UiMemory_Touch1_1_Skin2: I'll make your shot hurt even more!
UiMemory_Touch1_2_Skin2: Keep it up and I won't treat you.
UiMemory_Touch2_Skin2: Does it... hurt a little less now?
UiMemory_Touch2_1_Skin2: Hehe, I feel like I can keep going now.
UiMemory_Touch2_2_Skin2: Ugh, I'm supposed to be the one treating you...
UiMemory_DutchRubEnd2_Skin2: Hey! You're not supposed to hit the doctor!
Aside_Get_UiMemory1: Wait just a little longer, Eru. I'll come see you with a smile.
Aside_Upgrade_UiMemory1: If it grows any bigger... maybe I could ride it around?
UiMemory_SPSkill3: I'll protect everyone with my clover!
UiMemory_Ultimate1: You won't get away that easily, you know?
UiMemory_Ultimate3: From now on, this is my pond.
UiMemory_PowerAttack1: Will you sing for me, Eru?
UiMemory_Birthday: Happy birthday, Master. With you here, I think I've become... a little happier.
UiMemory_Gacha2: I'll try to move toward happiness, even if it's only a little at a time.
UiMemory_Gacha3: Across the river of misfortune, one step forward.
UiMemory_Line1: It's hard, but I won't give up. I'll keep walking.
UiMemory_Line2: Following where my heart points, slowly, one step at a time.
UiMemory_Line3: Until the raindrop on the clover... one day reaches happiness.
UiMemory_Lobby: I won't grin mindlessly like I used to.
UiMemory_EasterEgg_Deck: Sis, we don't belong in this world.
UiMemory_StartJourney1: Will you come with me, Master?
UiMemory_StartJourney2: Let's go. So that we can become happy.
UiMemory_StartJourney3: I want to protect Elias... the home of my sisters and friends.
UiMemory_ThemeIntro1: Right, I had memories like these too.
UiMemory_ThemeIntro2: There were plenty of hard times, but plenty of happy ones too.
UiMemory_ThemeIntro3: Looking back, more happened than I thought.
UiMemory_RescueAccept1: Can I really be happy again?
UiMemory_RescueRefuse1: That's enough. I don't want to go back anymore.
UiMemory_RescueRefuse2: Even if I go back, I'll just be left alone again.
LoveLetter_UiMemory:
Hello, Master.

Do you have a free day coming up? There's somewhere I'd like to visit with you.
I recently climbed halfway up Spirit Mountain, and the flowers there were incredibly beautiful. Someday I'd like the two of us to lie in the grass and bask in the sunlight. I want to weave the prettiest flowers into a crown, too. Once it's finished, I'll place it on your head myself.

So if you ever have a free day, make sure you tell me. Promise?
LoveCall_UiMemory:
Hello, Master?
Trying to say this over the phone feels... a little embarrassing.
I was watching the drizzling sky when you suddenly came to mind, so I decided to call.
Whenever I feel exhausted or miserable, hearing your voice... slowly makes me feel better.

Master, did you know?
The shell I left outside the pond always wore a raincoat.
A bright yellow raincoat. I thought that as long as it wore that... no amount of drizzle could hurt it.
But I was wrong.
No matter how tightly you wrap yourself in a raincoat, if you stay rooted in one place, the rain eventually seeps through.
Someday, you have to take off the raincoat and keep walking through the drizzle.

Thank you, Master.
You're the one who helped me understand that... so I really wanted to tell you.

Ugh, now that I've said it, this is so embarrassing. I'm hanging up, Master! I'll call again later!
Affinity_UiMemory_EP01_001: Master... why are you staring at me like that?
Affinity_UiMemory_EP01_002: Your eyes looked red. Were you crying...?
Affinity_UiMemory_EP01_003: ...Yeah. Something a little sad happened. You're still... as attentive as ever, Master.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP01_004: I suddenly felt like taking good care of you.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP01_005: You haven't changed, Master. Back then... and now. You're exactly as I remember...
Affinity_UiMemory_EP01_006: I was wondering what food might cheer you up, Ui.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP01_007: Haha, really? Then I'll look forward to it. I wonder what it will be.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP02_001: Are there many people who make wishes?
Affinity_UiMemory_EP02_002: Probably. Everyone wants to be happy, after all.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP02_003: Maybe they all feel too unhappy as they are now... because they want to escape their pain...
Affinity_UiMemory_EP02_004: Do you wish fewer people made wishes?
Affinity_UiMemory_EP02_005: Yes... I want everyone to be so happy that they never need to make a wish, and can even forget the word 'misfortune.'
Affinity_UiMemory_EP02_006: Is there a wish you want to make right now, Ui?
Affinity_UiMemory_EP02_007: Yes. A very earnest wish. Do you... want to know what it is, Master?
Affinity_UiMemory_EP03_001: Hmm... I don't really feel like eating today.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP03_002: No! You need something in your stomach to have any energy. Come on, open wide!
Affinity_UiMemory_EP03_003: Huh?! A-ah... mm... munch, munch... It is good... Maybe I do feel a little stronger?
Affinity_UiMemory_EP03_004: You're not feeling sick, are you? Should we just talk today?
Affinity_UiMemory_EP03_005: Yeah... okay. But there's something I want to say, and it may take a while... Will you hear me out?
Affinity_UiMemory_EP03_006: Sure. Come back when you feel like eating.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP03_007: Hmm... Even if I don't eat, I want to stay beside you. Being with you has always been fun. I want today to be like that too...
Affinity_UiMemory_EP04_001: Enduring it all is so hard. It's lonely... and isolating.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP04_002: Yeah. That's why I won't let you carry something so painful alone. Will you take my hand?
Affinity_UiMemory_EP04_003: Master...! Sob... Waaah! I-I want to hold your hand... sob!
Affinity_UiMemory_EP04_004: Enduring it alone is even harder.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP04_005: You... know that feeling? Have you ever endured something alone too, Master?
Affinity_UiMemory_EP04_006: That's when you have to smile and stay strong! Come on, shoulders back!
Affinity_UiMemory_EP04_007: L-like this...? Show me first, Master. I'll watch and copy you.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP05_001: My chest feels a little tight.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP05_003: Yeah. Some complicated things happened. Getting closer to happiness seems really difficult.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP05_004: Want some cold water? I'll fill it with ice.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP05_005: Yeah, thanks. I hope the ice water helps clear this tight feeling inside.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP05_006: I see. Come here. I'll hold you until your heart feels at ease.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP05_007: H-hold me? ...Okay. If it's you, Master, maybe it really will calm me down.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP06_001: Lately, even Eru's pranks don't make me laugh...
Affinity_UiMemory_EP06_002: Did Eru used to make you laugh a lot?
Affinity_UiMemory_EP06_003: Yeah... I think I was always laughing when I was with Eru. Hm? You felt the same, Eru? ...Thank you.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP06_004: When your heart has room to breathe again, your smile will return naturally. Don't worry.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP06_005: You think so? Then I won't force myself to smile. Thank you, Master.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP06_006: Really? Should I lend Eru a copy of The Priest's Collection of Side-Splitting Jokes?
Affinity_UiMemory_EP06_007: Would that really help? If so, lend it to me for a week.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP07_001: When do you think unhappiness ends?
Affinity_UiMemory_EP07_002: The moment someone appears and pulls you out of it.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP07_003: If someone like that exists, I would never forget my gratitude. That's why I want to tell you how grateful I am, Master.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP07_004: Perhaps in one of the moments when you're still struggling.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP07_005: I suppose we have no choice but to keep trying if we want to reach what we seek.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP07_006: I don't think anyone can know that.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP07_007: Yeah. That's why it hurts so much and feels so hard. Not knowing where it ends is frightening.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP08_001: Hmm... do you like me better when I'm smiling too, Master?
Affinity_UiMemory_EP08_002: I like Ui no matter what she looks like.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP08_003: Really? You like me just as I am? Hehe... Ah, I smiled without meaning to.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP08_004: Yes. Your smile has the power to brighten everything around you.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP08_005: I see. Is that why you smiled like that when you were with me before? I still remember your bright smile, Master.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP08_007: Because I felt like everyone was trying their best to make me smile.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP09_001: I once told you that I like anything you make. Do you remember?
Affinity_UiMemory_EP09_002: Yes, I remember. I'll make you something delicious today too!
Affinity_UiMemory_EP09_003: Thank you. I remember the food we ate together in the banquet hall. I'm looking forward to today too.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP09_004: Of course. Then shall I give you something with a pleasantly bitter taste today?
Affinity_UiMemory_EP09_005: Hmm... okay. But will you give me something sweet as well?
Affinity_UiMemory_EP09_006: Yes. You're still the same, right?
Affinity_UiMemory_EP09_007: Of course. My tastes haven't changed. They're just the same as before.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP10_001: On the way here, I saw my spirit friends all gathered and playing together.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP10_003: Tag. They looked like they were having so much fun. Maybe the old me would have joined them.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP10_004: Why didn't you stay and play with them, Ui?
Affinity_UiMemory_EP10_005: I didn't really feel like it. Besides, today I wanted to hurry back and eat the food you made.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP10_006: I see. What were you thinking as you watched them?
Affinity_UiMemory_EP10_007: They all looked happy. I hoped they could stay that way without fighting one another.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP11_001: When painful memories force their way into my heart without warning, I can't help feeling afraid.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP11_002: I think facing them head-on is one way to deal with them.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP11_003: But... some things are so frightening that merely facing them takes your breath away.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP11_004: Even when you're afraid, taking one step forward matters.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP11_005: Yes... I'll trust you and my sisters, and find the courage to take one more step.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP11_006: Try telling your fear to give you some warning before it barges in next time.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP11_007: Hmm... you're being such a tease today, Master. You're being especially mischievous.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP12_001: There are so many things in this world that vanish fleetingly before we can even reach out and hold on to them.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP12_002: Like the gold in my wallet?
Affinity_UiMemory_EP12_003: Hmm... I didn't know that... Are you really the leader of the church if you don't have any money?
Affinity_UiMemory_EP12_004: What made you feel that way, Ui?
Affinity_UiMemory_EP12_005: I love this warm moment so much... Sometimes I'm afraid that if I blink, all this happiness will vanish like a dream.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP12_006: It can shine beautifully precisely because it is fleeting.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP12_007: Listening to you, I think something being fleeting isn't necessarily only a sad thing.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP13_001: Sometimes I close my eyes without thinking about anything at all.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP13_002: How about sleeping when you're tired?
Affinity_UiMemory_EP13_003: That isn't what I meant, but sometimes simply getting a good night's sleep can make your heart feel lighter.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP13_004: Is there something you need to concentrate on?
Affinity_UiMemory_EP13_005: When I close my eyes, my view is blocked, so I think it helps me focus entirely on myself.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP13_006: I do it often too, because closing my eyes lets me sense something new.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP13_007: To truly feel the happiness you've been given, you have to close your eyes quietly and etch that warm sensation into your heart.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP14_001: Maybe it was because of yesterday's gentle drizzle. My heart felt soft and warm all day.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP14_002: I hope we get another gentle drizzle today.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP14_003: That would be lovely, but is happiness that comes so easily really happiness?
Affinity_UiMemory_EP14_004: Rain makes everything damp and sticky all day. I don't care for it.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP14_005: So you don't like drizzle, Master? I understand. What makes one person happy isn't necessarily happiness for someone else.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP14_006: After the drizzle comes a picnic! Shall we go to Spirit Mountain?
Affinity_UiMemory_EP14_007: Really?! Yes! Ah... am I getting too excited? Eru waits for me the day after it drizzles, too. Going there with you would be wonderful.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP15_001: I've received so much from my sisters that I want to give them a gift. Do you have any ideas?
Affinity_UiMemory_EP15_002: Your smile would be the greatest gift, Ui.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP15_003: I'm still afraid to smile freely in front of my sisters. But I'll trust you and try my best.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP15_004: Sion might like some gold as a gift.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP15_005: My second sister might like it, but wouldn't she feel awkward receiving it from me?
Affinity_UiMemory_EP15_006: How about giving them chocolates you made yourself?
Affinity_UiMemory_EP15_007: Come to think of it, all my sisters like sweets. Master, could you help me make chocolates? I'll make one for you while we're at it.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP16_001: I saw someone quietly making a wish on a shooting star. They looked happy just doing that.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP16_002: Happiness may be found in places that are smaller and simpler than we expect.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP16_003: Do you think so? Come to think of it, I often feel happy when I talk about ordinary things with you.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP16_004: Sometimes imagining a wish coming true is enough to make you happy.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP16_005: Do you imagine things like that often, Master? Hmm... your grin got awfully wide the moment I mentioned imagination.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP16_006: I saw you making a wish, so that person's wish won't come true.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP16_007: Then I can make a wish for that person's wish to come true.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP17_001: Please stay by my side just as you are, Master.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP17_002: Come find me whenever you miss me.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP17_003: Okay... since you said so, no lies, all right?
Affinity_UiMemory_EP17_004: Of course. I'll always be by your side, Ui.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP17_005: Thank you, Master. Thanks to you, each day will become a little happier.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP17_006: Don't expect that from someone who wanders without anywhere to go.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP17_007: Were you influenced by something unusual again? That sounds like something from the elves' theater.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP18_001: How can we ever reach complete happiness?
Affinity_UiMemory_EP18_002: When it comes to happiness, you should know more than I do, Ui.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP18_003: Me? I can't even be sure of my own happiness. How could what I know be the answer?
Affinity_UiMemory_EP18_005: But there isn't the slightest trace of happiness on your face when you say that.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP18_006: To be happy, you should keep someone you love close by.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP18_007: Hmm... I'm beside someone I love right now. Does that mean I'm already happy? Then are you happy right now too, Master?
Affinity_UiMemory_EP19_001: I feel better whenever I come to the banquet hall. Is it because you're here?
Affinity_UiMemory_EP19_002: I feel uncomfortable when the apostles all come rushing in, though.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP19_003: Are you really allowed to say things like that as the Master?
Affinity_UiMemory_EP19_004: Wouldn't the atmosphere be fun even without me?
Affinity_UiMemory_EP19_005: No, it won't do without you. This place feels safe only when you're here.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP19_006: If it helps you feel at ease, I'll spend more time in the banquet hall.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP19_007: Yes. Thank you. Thanks to you, I have more and more places where I belong.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP20_001: Sometimes you serve apostles food they dislike. Why?
Affinity_UiMemory_EP20_002: The food served each day is predetermined.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP20_003: It's more systematic than I expected. Sion's convenience store isn't like that...
Affinity_UiMemory_EP20_004: Eating food you dislike is good for your health too.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP20_005: I don't like bitter things, but if that's how it is... will you still give me plenty of sweet food?
Affinity_UiMemory_EP20_006: I like seeing the apostles' bewildered faces.
Affinity_UiMemory_EP20_007: And you keep pulling my cheeks too. Sometimes, you really do have a strange side, Master.
